title: Map
statementMd:
There is an area map that is a rectangular matrix $*n* × *m*$, each cell of the matrix contains the average height of a corresponding area part. Peter works for a company that has to build several cities within this area, each of the cities will occupy a rectangle $*a* × *b*$ cells on the map. To start construction works in a particular place Peter needs to remove excess ground from the construction site where a new city will be built. To do so he chooses a cell of the minimum height within this site, and removes excess ground from other cells of the site down to this minimum level. Let's consider that to lower the ground level from $*h*_{2}$ to $*h*_{1}$ ($*h*_{1} ≤ *h*_{2}$) they need to remove $*h*_{2} - *h*_{1}$ ground units.

Let's call a site's position optimal, if the amount of the ground removed from this site is minimal compared to other possible positions. Peter constructs cities according to the following algorithm: from all the optimum site's positions he chooses the uppermost one. If this position is not unique, he chooses the leftmost one. Then he builds a city on this site. Peter repeats this process untill he can build at least one more city. For sure, he cannot carry out construction works on the occupied cells. Would you, please, help Peter place cities according to the algorithm?

## Input

The first line contains four space-separated integers: map sizes $*n*$, $*m*$ and city sizes $*a*$, $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a* ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$, $1 ≤ *b* ≤ *m* ≤ 1000$). Then there follow $*n*$ lines, each contains $*m*$ non-negative space-separated numbers, describing the height matrix. Each number doesn't exceed $10^{9}$.

## Output

In the first line output $*k*$ — the amount of constructed cities. In each of the following $*k*$ lines output 3 space-separated numbers — the row number and the column number of the upper-left corner of a subsequent construction site, and the amount of the ground to remove from it. Output the sites in the order of their building up.
statementZhMd:
这是一个区域地图，它是一个矩形矩阵 $*n* × *m*$，矩阵中的每个单元格都包含对应区域部分的平均高度。Peter 所在的公司需要在该区域内建造若干座城市，每座城市将占据地图上一个 $*a* × *b*$ 的矩形区域。为了在某个地点开始施工，Peter 需要清除将要建造城市的施工区域中的多余地面。为此，他选择该区域内高度最低的单元格，并将该区域其他单元格的地面降低到这一最低高度。可以认为，将地面高度从 $*h*_{2}$ 降低到 $*h*_{1}$（$*h*_{1} ≤ *h*_{2}$）需要清除 $*h*_{2} - *h*_{1}$ 个单位的地面。

如果某个施工区域被清除的地面总量相较于其他可能的位置最少，则称该位置是最优的。Peter 按照以下算法建造城市：在所有最优施工位置中，他选择最靠上的位置。如果该位置不唯一，则选择最靠左的位置。然后，他在该位置建造一座城市。Peter 不断重复这一过程，直到无法再建造至少一座城市为止。当然，他不能在已被占用的单元格上进行施工。请帮助 Peter 按照该算法安排城市的位置。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个用空格分隔的整数：地图的大小 $*n*$、$*m*$ 以及城市的大小 $*a*$、$*b*$（$1 ≤ *a* ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$，$1 ≤ *b* ≤ *m* ≤ 1000$）。接下来有 $*n*$ 行，每行包含 $*m*$ 个非负数，描述高度矩阵。每个数都不超过 $10^{9}$。

## 输出格式

第一行输出 $*k*$，表示建造的城市数量。接下来的 $*k*$ 行中，每行输出 3 个用空格分隔的数：下一座城市施工区域左上角的行号和列号，以及需要从该区域清除的地面总量。按照城市建造的顺序输出这些施工区域。
